d.d: A person, especially a minor, both or (rarely) one of whose parents have died.
A person, especially a minor, whose parents have permanently abandoned them.

d.x: What do you do when you come across two orphaned polar bear cubs?

d.d: To make unavailable, as by removing the last remaining pointer or reference to.
d.x: When you removed that image tag, you orphaned the resized icon.

d.d: A residential institution for the care and protection of orphans.
Made an orphan by the death of one's parents.
